game_concept: A racing platformer set in Sand Dunes – Caravan Camp, a caravan camp: the oasis keeper must handle vultures while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Program Assembler: Assemble a working program from shuffled code blocks in the right order.
theme: Sand Dunes – Caravan Camp: a caravan camp
core_gameplay_loop: In Caravan Camp, repeat each round: Assemble a working program from shuffled code blocks in the right order. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the oasis keeper ahead. Then check the program_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the palm grove by solving code steps involving program_ok that move the oasis keeper forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the palm grove first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 10 (extended tier): Program Assembler
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Program Assembler' (Week 9 slot 13), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Caravan Camp'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how program_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vultures in Caravan Camp.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
